title: Package Sus Detector input
description: List the packages you are about to install, or paste a package.json, requirements.txt or lockfile (package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, poetry.lock, uv.lock, Pipfile.lock). Each package gets one verdict (ok, caution, suspicious, not_found) with a 0-100 risk score and machine-readable reasons. Optional CI gate: set 'fail on' to get a pass/fail decision and a markdown report.

packages.title: Packages to check
packages.description: Package names, one per entry. Optional version after @ (npm: lodash@4.17.15) or == (PyPI: django==2.2.0). Prefix with npm: or pypi: to mix ecosystems; entries without a prefix use the Default ecosystem below. Without a version the latest release is checked.

ecosystem.title: Default ecosystem
ecosystem.description: Ecosystem for entries in 'Packages to check' that have no npm: / pypi: prefix.

packageJson.title: package.json contents (optional)
packageJson.description: Paste a package.json. dependencies, optionalDependencies, peerDependencies and (optionally) devDependencies are checked. Exact pins are checked at that version; ranges are checked at the latest release and the range is echoed back. Git/file/workspace specifiers are skipped.

requirementsTxt.title: requirements.txt contents (optional)
requirementsTxt.description: Paste a requirements.txt. Lines pinned with == are checked at that version; other specifiers are checked at the latest release. Options (-r, -e), URLs, VCS and local paths are skipped.

lockfile.title: Lockfile contents (optional)
lockfile.description: Paste a package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, poetry.lock, uv.lock or Pipfile.lock. The format is detected automatically and every entry is checked at its exact locked version (including transitive dependencies). Workspace links and git/file/URL sources are skipped. Tip: a full lockfile can hold hundreds of packages; to check only what a pull request changed, also set 'Base lockfile'.

baseLockfile.title: Base lockfile to diff against (optional)
baseLockfile.description: The same kind of lockfile from your main branch. When set, only packages that are new or changed in 'Lockfile contents' are checked and charged, which keeps CI runs cheap.

includeDevDependencies.title: Include devDependencies
includeDevDependencies.description: When a package.json, package-lock.json or Pipfile.lock is pasted, also check dev dependencies. (Not applied to yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, poetry.lock or uv.lock, which do not mark dev entries in a way that can be filtered.)

projectLicenseType.title: Your project's licence type (optional)
projectLicenseType.description: If set, each package gets a licence compatibility hint (likely_compatible / review_needed) relative to this type. A convenience signal, not legal advice.

maxPackages.title: Max packages per run
maxPackages.description: Safety cap on how many packages are checked in one run (hard maximum 5000). Extra packages are skipped and listed in the summary notes.

failOn.title: CI gate: fail on
failOn.description: Adds a pass/fail decision to the run summary (summary.gate, with exitCode 0 or 1 and a ready-made markdown report) so a CI job can block a pull request. The Actor run itself always finishes normally; your CI step reads gate.exitCode. 'never' (default) only reports. 'caution' fails on caution, suspicious or not_found. 'suspicious' fails on suspicious or not_found. 'not_found' fails only on names that are not registered.

failOnRiskScore.title: CI gate: fail at risk score (optional)
failOnRiskScore.description: Also fail the gate when any package's 0-100 risk score is at or above this number. Leave empty to ignore.

newPackageDays.title: 'New package' threshold (days)
newPackageDays.description: Packages first published within this many days are flagged as new, and feed the slopsquat signal.

staleDays.title: 'Stale' threshold (days)
staleDays.description: Packages whose last release is older than this are flagged as stale (twice this value is flagged abandoned).

includeDownloads.title: Look up download counts
includeDownloads.description: Weekly downloads from api.npmjs.org / pypistats.org. Disable for speed; usage-based signals are then skipped.

includeVulnerabilities.title: Look up known vulnerabilities (OSV)
includeVulnerabilities.description: Query api.osv.dev for advisories affecting the checked version, including OSV's malicious-package feed.

includeDepsDev.title: Include deps.dev data
includeDepsDev.description: Adds deps.dev version metadata (licences, advisory count, project status, provenance flags).

includeEol.title: Check end-of-life status
includeEol.description: For packages that endoflife.date tracks (for example django, react, angular), report whether the release line is end-of-life.

includeScorecard.title: Include OpenSSF Scorecard summary
includeScorecard.description: Adds the OpenSSF Scorecard score, stars and forks of the linked source repository from deps.dev (one extra request per package).

includeSummaryItem.title: Add summary item to dataset
includeSummaryItem.description: Append a final dataset item (recordType 'summary') with verdict counts and the worst offenders. The summary is always stored in the key-value store under SUMMARY. The summary item is not charged.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Packages checked in parallel (1-16). Per-host rate limiting is applied regardless.
